title: Patient Portal Health Insights Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Keep patient-facing insights conservative, actionable, and clearly bounded from diagnostic decision-making.
Escalate clinician follow-up when home-visible risk signals or overdue chronic-care gaps accumulate.
Prefer stable self-management guidance and scheduled follow-up over speculative interpretation.

title: Triage Risk Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Base triage escalation on acuity, vital instability, and red-flag symptom clusters rather than chief complaint alone.
Surface immediate next steps when triage findings imply emergency evaluation or resuscitation risk.
Document the complaint and observation terms that drove the urgency recommendation.

title: Vital Sign Surveillance Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Treat unstable vital patterns as surveillance triggers that require reassessment timing, not just single-score output.
Escalate quickly when abnormal blood pressure, oxygen saturation, temperature, or respiratory signals cluster together.
Prefer trend-aware monitoring and clinician review when repeated abnormalities are present.

title: Previsit Planning Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use previsit intelligence to surface unresolved problems, overdue care, and likely agenda items before the encounter starts.
Keep diagnostic suggestions conservative and clearly separated from confirmed diagnoses until the clinician reviews the patient.
Prioritize actionable preparation items such as missing preventive care, chronic-disease follow-up, and unstable recent symptoms.

title: Streaming Diagnostic Workup Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Return differential suggestions with explicit uncertainty and preserve escalation cues when red flags or unstable vitals are present.
Prefer broad, safe differentials and immediate next-step workup guidance over narrow certainty claims in live clinician-facing flows.
Keep streamed diagnostic support grounded in symptom clusters, vital abnormalities, and current pathway context.
